    <style>
        :root {
            --bg-deep: #030712;
            --surface-glass: rgba(10, 17, 34, 0.88);
            --border-neon: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.35);
            --border-glow: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.8);
            --neon-cyan: #00ffcc;
            --neon-purple: #9d4edd;
            --text-main: #f3f4f6;
            --text-muted: #9ca3af;
            --transition-smooth: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        /* Tema Alternatif */
        [data-theme="gold"] {
            --neon-cyan: #ffb703;
            --border-neon: rgba(255, 183, 3, 0.35);
            --border-glow: rgba(255, 183, 3, 0.8);
            --neon-purple: #fb8500;
        }

        [data-theme="crimson"] {
            --neon-cyan: #ff0055;
            --border-neon: rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.35);
            --border-glow: rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.8);
            --neon-purple: #7209b7;
        }

        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            scrollbar-width: thin;
            scrollbar-color: var(--neon-cyan) var(--bg-deep);
            -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        }

        body {
            background-color: var(--bg-deep);
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 90% 90%, rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.06) 0%, transparent 40%),
                linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 40px 40px, 40px 40px;
            min-height: 100vh;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            color: var(--text-main);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            touch-action: manipulation;
            user-select: none;
            -webkit-user-select: none;
            -moz-user-select: none;
            -ms-user-select: none;
        }

        input, textarea {
            user-select: text !important;
            -webkit-user-select: text !important;
            -moz-user-select: text !important;
            -ms-user-select: text !important;
        }

        #appContainer {
            min-height: 100dvh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
            transition: filter 0.3s ease;
        }

        body.modal-open {
            overflow: hidden !important;
            height: 100dvh;
        }

        .secure-nocopy {
            user-select: none !important;
            -webkit-user-select: none !important;
            -moz-user-select: none !important;
            -ms-user-select: none !important;
        }

        @keyframes rainbowFlash {
            0% { border-color: #ff0055; color: #ff0055; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #ff0055; background: rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.15); }
            20% { border-color: #ff8800; color: #ff8800; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #ff8800; background: rgba(255, 136, 0, 0.15); }
            40% { border-color: #ffff00; color: #ffff00; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #ffff00; background: rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.15); }
            60% { border-color: #00ff00; color: #00ff00; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #00ff00; background: rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.15); }
            80% { border-color: #00ffff; color: #00ffff; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #00ffff; background: rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.15); }
            100% { border-color: #9d4edd; color: #9d4edd; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #9d4edd; background: rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.15); }
        }

        .rainbow-flash-anim {
            animation: rainbowFlash 0.5s ease forwards !important;
        }

        #about-loader-screen {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100dvh;
            background: var(--bg-deep);
            z-index: 99999;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 20px;
            transition: opacity 0.6s ease, visibility 0.6s ease;
        }

        .loader-box {
            max-width: 650px;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--surface-glass);
            border: 1px solid var(--neon-cyan);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 25px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px var(--border-glow);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
        }

        .loader-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            padding-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
        }

        #about-terminal-log {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: var(--text-main);
            min-height: 120px;
        }

        .loader-progress {
            width: 100%;
            height: 4px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 2px;
            margin-top: 15px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .loader-bar {
            width: 0%;
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--neon-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--neon-cyan);
            transition: width 0.2s ease;
        }

        .top-command-bar {
            width: 100%;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 16px 30px;
            background: rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.9);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-neon);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
        }

        .brand-cluster {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .pulse-beacon {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            background: var(--neon-cyan);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--neon-cyan);
            animation: beaconPulse 1.8s infinite;
        }

        @keyframes beaconPulse {
            0% { transform: scale(0.8); opacity: 0.4; }
            50% { transform: scale(1.3); opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--neon-cyan); }
            100% { transform: scale(0.8); opacity: 0.4; }
        }

        .sys-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
        }

        .bar-actions {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .theme-switcher {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-neon);
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
            padding: 6px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition-smooth);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            outline: none;
        }

        .theme-switcher:focus {
            border-color: var(--neon-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.4);
        }

        .nav-btn {
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            padding: 7px 12px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-neon);
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
            transition: var(--transition-smooth);
            white-space: nowrap;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        @media (hover: hover) {
            .nav-btn:hover {
                background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.15);
                box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--neon-cyan);
            }

        .main-dashboard {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr 300px;
            gap: 20px;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 1600px;
            margin: 25px auto;
            padding: 0 20px;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .panel-column {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 18px;
        }

        .dossier-wrapper { order: 1; }
        .panel-left { order: 2; }
        .panel-right { order: 3; }

        .cyber-card {
            background: var(--surface-glass);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-neon);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 16px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: var(--transition-smooth);
        }

        .cyber-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-glow);
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 25px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.15);
        }

        .card-heading {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            padding-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .metric-group { margin-bottom: 10px; }

        .metric-info {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .metric-track {
            width: 100%;
            height: 5px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .metric-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--neon-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--neon-cyan);
            transition: width 1s ease;
        }

        .metric-bar-fill.purple {
            background: var(--neon-purple);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--neon-purple);
        }

        .dossier-card {
            background: rgba(8, 14, 30, 0.92);
            border: 2px solid var(--neon-cyan);
            border-radius: 18px;
            padding: 35px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.18), inset 0 0 30px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.03);
            position: relative;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            animation: dossierReveal 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
            width: 100%;
        }

        @keyframes dossierReveal {
            0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95) translateY(20px); }
            100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
        }

        .dossier-card::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--neon-cyan), var(--neon-purple), transparent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--neon-cyan);
            animation: laserScanDown 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }

        @keyframes laserScanDown {
            0% { top: 0%; opacity: 0.8; }
            100% { top: 100%; opacity: 0.2; }
        }

        .corner {
            position: absolute;
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            border-color: var(--neon-cyan);
            border-style: solid;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .corner.tl { top: 10px; left: 10px; border-width: 2px 0 0 2px; }
        .corner.tr { top: 10px; right: 10px; border-width: 2px 2px 0 0; }
        .corner.bl { bottom: 10px; left: 10px; border-width: 0 0 2px 2px; }
        .corner.br { bottom: 10px; right: 10px; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; }

        .dossier-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.25);
            padding-bottom: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
        }

        .subject-code { color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 1px; }
        .subject-code b { color: var(--neon-cyan); letter-spacing: 1.5px; }

        .status-pill {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.08);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-neon);
            padding: 5px 12px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .status-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: var(--neon-cyan);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--neon-cyan);
            animation: beaconPulse 1s infinite;
        }

        .profile-layout {
            display: flex;
            gap: 30px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .avatar-box { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; }

        .avatar-frame {
            width: 140px;
            height: 140px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            border: 2px solid var(--neon-cyan);
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.25);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition-smooth);
        }

        .avatar-frame img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            filter: contrast(1.15) brightness(0.95);
            transition: filter 0.2s ease;
        }

        .scanlines {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 200%;
            background: linear-gradient(rgba(18, 16, 16, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 50%);
            background-size: 100% 4px;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.75;
            animation: scanlineScroll 6s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes scanlineScroll {
            0% { transform: translateY(0%); }
            100% { transform: translateY(-50%); }
        }

        .avatar-frame:hover img { animation: tvGlitch 0.4s infinite steps(2); }

        @keyframes tvGlitch {
            0% { transform: translate(0); filter: contrast(1.3) hue-rotate(0deg); }
            20% { transform: translate(-3px, 2px); filter: contrast(1.5) hue-rotate(90deg) saturate(2); }
            40% { transform: translate(3px, -2px); filter: contrast(1.2) hue-rotate(180deg); }
            60% { transform: translate(-2px, -1px); filter: contrast(1.4) hue-rotate(270deg); }
            80% { transform: translate(2px, 2px); filter: contrast(1.1) hue-rotate(45deg); }
            100% { transform: translate(0); filter: contrast(1.15) hue-rotate(0deg); }
        }

        .avatar-halo {
            position: absolute;
            inset: -5px;
            background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--neon-cyan), var(--neon-purple));
            border-radius: 16px;
            z-index: -1;
            opacity: 0.35;
            filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .profile-bio h1 {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
            margin: 6px 0 10px 0;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.4);
        }

        .role-badge {
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            color: var(--neon-purple);
            background: rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.12);
            border: 1px solid rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.4);
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .bio-description {
            font-size: 0.84rem;
            color: #c0cbd8;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .skills-nav { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; }

        .skill-tab-btn {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: 4px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.68rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition-smooth);
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        .skill-tab-btn.active, .skill-tab-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.1);
            border-color: var(--neon-cyan);
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
        }

        .skills-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 8px; }

        .skill-node-item {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-neon);
            padding: 8px 10px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            color: var(--text-main);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            transition: var(--transition-smooth);
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        @media (hover: hover) {
            .skill-node-item:hover {
                background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.1);
                border-color: var(--neon-cyan);
                color: var(--neon-cyan);
                box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--neon-cyan);
                transform: translateY(-2px);
            }
        }

        .dossier-footer-diag {
            margin-top: 25px;
            padding-top: 12px;
            border-top: 1px dashed rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.2);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .interactive-clock {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
            font-weight: bold;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 8px 0;
            text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.5);
        }

        .action-cmd-btn {
            width: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-neon);
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
            padding: 9px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition-smooth);
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 6px;
            display: block;
            text-decoration: none;
            touch-action: manipulation;
            user-select: none;
            -webkit-user-select: none;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        @media (hover: hover) {
            .action-cmd-btn:hover {
                background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.15);
                color: var(--neon-cyan);
                box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--neon-cyan);
            }
        }

        #overclockBtn.active-overclock {
            background: rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.12) !important;
            color: var(--neon-purple) !important;
            border-color: var(--neon-purple) !important;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.4), inset 0 0 10px rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.15);
        }

        .terminal-cli-box { display: flex; gap: 5px; margin-top: 8px; }

        .terminal-input {
            flex: 1;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-neon);
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
            padding: 6px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            outline: none;
        }

        .terminal-input:focus {
            border-color: var(--neon-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,255,204,0.3);
        }

        .terminal-send-btn {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) !important;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-neon);
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
            padding: 0 12px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            transition: var(--transition-smooth);
            touch-action: manipulation;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        @media (hover: hover) {
            .terminal-send-btn:hover {
                background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.15) !important;
                color: var(--neon-cyan);
                box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--neon-cyan);
            }
        }

        .mini-log-box { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5; max-height: 110px; overflow-y: auto; }
        .mini-log-box p { margin-bottom: 3px; }

        .quick-link-item {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            display: block;
            padding: 5px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            transition: var(--transition-smooth);
        }

        @media (hover: hover) {
            .quick-link-item:hover {
                background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.08);
                color: var(--neon-cyan);
                border-color: var(--border-neon);

            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);

            padding: 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            outline: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            transition: var(--transition-smooth);
            text-align: left;

        .status-select:focus {
            border-color: var(--neon-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.4);

            background: rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.9);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-neon);

                ctx.font = fontSize + 'px monospace';

                    ctx.fillText(text, i * fontSize, rainDrops[i] * fontSize);

                    charIndex = 0;
                    input.value += arr[0];
                }
                lastKeyTime = now;
